mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up our time together, I hope the quiet wisdom of the Maine coast stays with you, long after the last lobster shell has been tossed aside and the sun’s dipped below the horizon. These stories aren’t just about a place—they’re gentle reminders about how to live well, no matter where you find yourself. So, what can you take with you? For starters, it’s those small, shared moments that often mean the most. The laughter around a table, the warmth of a simple joke—these little things keep us connected and resilient when life gets tough. Change? It’s not just something to endure—sometimes, it’s the doorway to growth and new beginnings. And generosity, paired with real gratitude, lays the groundwork for lasting community, wherever you call home. Most of all, living with intention brings clarity and courage, and gives you a sense of peace that can’t be shaken by the tides. So, as you move through your own days, maybe try to notice the beauty tucked inside the ordinary—a shared meal, a walk outside, a quiet story as evening falls. When things don’t go as planned, let laughter lighten your step. And when life shifts, welcome change with an open heart. Give freely, receive what comes your way with gratitude, and remember—you’re always part of something bigger. A story woven from kindness, courage, and the simple act of being present. Life, like the sea, is always moving. There’ll be storms and setbacks, but also moments of unexpected joy and deep connection. Trust that you have the strength to weather what comes—and the wisdom to enjoy the simple pleasures along the way. The lessons of the coast are yours to carry now. Gentle, steady, and always right there when you need them.
